import pandas as pd
import polars as pl


def top_sales(df):
    """Filter rows where amount > 100 and sort by amount descending, working with any dataframe type."""
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    result = (
        nw_df
        .filter(nw.col("amount") > 100)
        .sort("amount", descending=True)
        .to_native()
    )
